title: SIREN language model ranks small molecules for RNA targets without structure
summary: SIREN outperformed RNAmigos2, RNAmigos++ and rDock on four held-out ROBIN riboswitch targets and performed well on an independent HIV-1 TAR benchmark without a conformational ensemble. Prospective screening against IRES-derived RNA hairpins from cMyc and XIAP mRNAs identified multiple experimentally validated micromolar-affinity binders. The number of binders and hit rate are not given in the abstract; this is a preprint.
ai_technology: SIREN sequence-based model integrating a pretrained RNA language model, molecular language model embeddings and physicochemical descriptors

evidence.tested: Prospective screening against cMyc and XIAP hairpins with experimentally validated micromolar binders.
evidence.unknown: Number of binders and hit rate; preprint; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Pretrained RNA and molecular language models for RNA-small molecule interaction ranking
